title: Observer separates causal trace projection from raw unified timeline
summary: Chrome Observer trace-ui3 renders the active or most recent correlated chain as a dedicated Current/recent trace tree using span parentage, while Unified Timeline remains the raw event evidence stream.
claims: The trace projection selects an active correlation first, otherwise the most recent correlated event.
Trace rows are indented from span_id/parent_span_id ancestry.
The trace header shows a short correlation prefix, event count and source_quality.
Collapsed correlated raw timeline rows show a short correlation prefix.
Raw MCP/TERM polling noise remains and is tracked separately under OBS-07.
decision: Use the trace projection as the operator-facing causal view; keep Unified Timeline as drill-down evidence and compact its self-noise separately.
rationale: A flat 300-event stream is not a usable representation of one causal run even when every event is correctly correlated.

evidence.note: Trace UI implementation and test evidence.
Static UI contract verifies trace section, rendering function and correlation prefix.
